zh.d: 不学乐器也行：从听到的结构、体裁与风格开始，先建立耳朵的判断。

en.t: I want to understand what I hear
en.d: No instrument needed: start from form, genre and style, and build judgement by ear.

zh.d: 从选琴、第一次发声到能完整弹一首，按你的时间和预算铺路。

en.t: I want to learn an instrument
en.d: From choosing one and the first sound to playing a whole piece, paced to your time and budget.

zh.d: 旋律、和声、歌词与结构，从一句动机到能交付的 Demo。

en.t: I want to write a song
en.d: Melody, harmony, lyrics and form, from a one-bar idea to a deliverable demo.

zh.t: 我想给视频或游戏配乐
zh.d: 贴片、情绪曲线、交互分层与交付格式，按画面而不是按小节写。

en.t: I want to score film or games
en.d: Sync, emotional arc, interactive layers and delivery formats, written to picture rather than bars.

zh.t: 我想用 AI 做音乐
zh.d: 工具选型、提示词、可控性与权利边界，把生成结果变成能交付的成品。

en.t: I want to make music with AI
en.d: Tool choice, prompting, control and rights, turning generations into deliverables.

zh.d: 录音到母带的最后一公里：修、混、母带、分轨与响度标准。

en.t: I want to fix, mix or deliver
en.d: The last mile from recording to master: repair, mix, master, stems and loudness standards.

zh.d: 没有乐器经验，也读不懂谱。先建立听觉词汇，别急着买设备。

en.d: No instrument, no notation. Build listening vocabulary first; do not buy gear yet.

zh.d: 能弹几首、看得懂简单谱。把零散的手上功夫接上乐理与曲目。

en.d: A few pieces and simple notation. Connect technique to theory and repertoire.

zh.d: 有作品，但混音与交付不稳。补齐制作链与判断标准。

en.d: You finish songs, but mixing and delivery wobble. Fill in the production chain and standards.

zh.d: 靠音乐接活。按项目类型找工具档案、交付规范与客户流程。

en.d: You take paid work. Go straight to tool profiles, delivery specs and client workflow.

scenes.en: A first instrument for a child
